mapper.select: SELECT U.ID AS "id" ,U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,U.PROVIDER AS "provider" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM U.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "joinedAt" FROM T_USER U WHERE 1=1 AND U.ID = #{userId} AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T_INVITE (INVITEE_ID, INVITER_ID) VALUES (#{inviteeId}, #{inviterId}) ON CONFLICT (INVITEE_ID) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_INVITE WHERE INVITER_ID = #{inviterId}

SELECT U.NICKNAME AS "nickname" ,(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM I.INS_DAY) * 1000)::BIGINT AS "at" FROM T_INVITE I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.INVITEE_ID WHERE 1=1 AND I.INVITER_ID = #{inviterId} AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY I.INS_DAY DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT U.NICKNAME FROM T_INVITE I JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = I.INVITER_ID WHERE I.INVITEE_ID = #{inviteeId}
